title: Maxwell the Cat Theme
blurb: A frantic fiddle tune, a low-poly cat, and eternal rotation. Maxwell has been inserted into every video game, every music video and every corner of the internet, always spinning, always accompanied by this song, never explained. There is no joke here, no punchline and no context, just a cat and a fiddle and the collective decision that this is funny, and the emptiness is doing all of the work. Play it and something in the room will start rotating in sympathy, whether that is a person, a chair or a mildly concerned pet.
origin: The theme attached to the viral spinning Maxwell the Cat 3D model.
